substrate-attest-rs-main/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "substrate-attest"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "ATTEST opcode (R10): add trust score to an observation"
license = "MIT"
authors = ["SuperInstance"]
repository = "https://github.com/SuperInstance/substrate-attest"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["attest", "observation", "substrate", "jev-quilt"]
categories = ["data-structures"]

[dependencies]
observation-primitive = "0.1"
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
